title: Go-Karting, Skate Parks and Family Bike Rides
description: Days out on wheels: junior go-karting, free skate parks for scooters and skateboards, roller rinks and traffic-free family bike rides, with safety tips.
intro: Fast karts, fresh tricks and the open trail. Days out on wheels are a huge hit with kids and teens, and some cost nothing at all.

image.alt: Two go-kart drivers on a race track

blocks.title: Scout’s wheels verdict
blocks.text: Karting tracks set their own age and height rules, so check before you book. Skate parks are free, but helmets are non-negotiable.

sections.html: Wear a helmet for skating, scooting and cycling, and pads for beginners. At karting tracks, follow the briefing and the marshals. Read go-karting for kids, skate parks and scooter days and family cycling days out.

faqs.q: What age can children go karting?
faqs.a: It depends on the track. Many offer junior sessions with smaller karts, with minimum ages and heights. Check the track’s rules before booking.

cardText: Junior karting, skate parks, roller rinks and bike trails.
